title: a large structure referenced while its owner is open still moves to the caller when returned
purpose: Observe failure, cleanup and lifetime ordering during execution.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0; region walk summaries by #9
provenance.expected_basis: spec 11.6: make owns the 100 resources while a View refers to them; returning the array frees them for the caller, which owns them and destroys them (newest first) after printing, not when make returns.
